_help.awardsFor2: How many highlight awards show after a 2-player game. More = more stories, but a busier page. Try 2–4.
_help.awardsFor3: How many highlight awards show after a 3-player game. Try 2–4.
_help.awardsFor4: How many highlight awards show after a 4-player game. Try 3–5.
_help.awardPriority: Which awards may show, and in what order they are picked: 1 = picked first. 0 = never shown. No player gets a second award until everyone has one. Awards never add Magic.
_help.photoFinishMax: Shows when the winner's lead is this small or smaller (it then replaces The deciding turn). Higher = it shows more often. Try 2–5.
_help.comebackMin: The winner must have trailed by at least this much at some point. Higher = only big comebacks count, so it shows less often. Try 8–15.
_help.twoBirdsMin: The best cast must have made at least this many words. Higher = a rarer award. Try 2–3.
_help.secretLeaderMinRounds: The player must have led on their own for at least this many rounds. Higher = a rarer award. Try 2–5.
_help.generousMin: At least this many of the player's seeds ended up in rivals' words. Higher = a rarer award. Try 3–6.
_help.maxMarkers: The most little markers drawn on the chart's lines (tangles first, then award moments, then lead changes). Higher = more detail but busier; 0 = none. Try 4–8.
_help.chartDrawSeconds: When the page opens, the lines draw themselves left to right over this long. Higher = a slower reveal; 0 = they appear at once (reduce motion always does). Try 1–2.
_help.chartLineWidth: Higher = thicker, bolder lines. 3 is medium (the chart is 360 wide). Try 2–4.
_help.chartHeight: The chart never gets shorter than this; on big screens it grows to fill the page. Higher = a taller chart on small screens (the page scrolls rather than squash it). Try 180–260.
_help.pageFill: On Results and Scorecard, everything grows until the page fills this much of the screen's height (0.94 = 94%), so a big screen doesn't show a small page in empty space. Never shrinks below normal size. Try 0.85–0.97.
_help.maxZoom: A cap on that growing, so huge screens don't get giant text. 2.25 = up to 2¼ times normal size. Higher = can grow bigger. Try 1.5–2.5.
_help.awardPriority.photoFinish: Photo finish ("Won by just 2 Magic"). 1 = picked first, bigger numbers = picked later, 0 = never shown. Nobody gets a second award until everyone has one. Awards never add Magic.
_help.awardPriority.deciding: The deciding turn ("Took the lead for good in round 5"). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown. Never shows together with Photo finish.
_help.awardPriority.biggestTurn: Biggest turn (most Magic in one cast). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown.
_help.awardPriority.twoBirds: Two birds (several words from one seed). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown.
_help.awardPriority.borrowedBloom: Borrowed bloom (a word grown mostly from rivals' seeds). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown.
_help.awardPriority.knotTier: Knot tier (tangled a rival's glyphling). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown. Never shows together with Brave knot.
_help.awardPriority.braveKnot: Brave knot (tangled their own glyphling to end the game). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown.
_help.awardPriority.tangleHarvest: Tangle harvest (most Magic from tangles). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown.
_help.awardPriority.comeback: Comeback (was far behind and still won). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown.
_help.awardPriority.secretLeader: Secret leader (ahead for most rounds, and nobody knew). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown.
_help.awardPriority.longestWord: Longest word. Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown.
_help.awardPriority.soloGrower: Solo grower (most Magic from words of only their own seeds). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown.
_help.awardPriority.rareSeed: Rare seed (a word with Q, Z, X or J). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown.
_help.awardPriority.generousGardener: Generous gardener (their seeds grew into rivals' words). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown.
_help.awardPriority.freshStart: Fresh start (most Magic right after a Refresh). Lower number = picked sooner; 0 = never shown.
